name: tree-public-overath-dual-interface-veto
hypothesis: When AF3 and Boltz both have minimum interface ipSAE below 0.1, tie that jointly unsupported interface regime at zero; otherwise retain AF3. Both discovery distributions have a large near-zero regime; 0.1 is one rounded cutoff chosen from signal scale, not labels or a sweep. Agreement on absent interface support may be more useful than globally averaging predictions.
